instructions: Native tiles preserve source pixel values, with nearest-neighbor enlargement where needed. Candidate tiles identify Python proposals only. Diagnostic tiles (line suppression, likelihood, assignments and scores) are fallible derived views, not native evidence. Ambiguity contact sheets preserve each native crop as a labeled cell; use the manifest row and column to match item IDs. Each ambiguity crop is also attached individually with its source_bbox_px, nearby candidate row IDs and competing series. Crowded strip crops are unchanged source pixels, split horizontally to cover the full calibrated low-pressure strip from top to bottom. Search every complex-region native tile for missed CO2 markers; never use an annotated ring or count as coordinate evidence.
